title: hardening: protected PATH filter compares a not-yet-existing PATH leaf lexically, so a leaf under a link, 8.3, subst or mapped-drive ancestor of the project can read as outside
description:
This residual of the protected-profile Windows alias work is known and QA-accepted, and it is not tracked anywhere else. Recorded at 16:46Z on 2026-10-30 by RF06b rev 3's planner (architect-bd1eb82d, msg-2ff1c7ae) and in Serena decision-protected-windows-alias-refusal (line 30): "A not-yet-existing PATH leaf below a link, 8.3, subst or mapped-drive ancestor is still compared lexically. QA accepted this, and JetBrains shares it. An ancestor walk or a dev+ino identity check would close it later."

Why it matters: isOutsideProject resolves existing paths through realpath (VS Code) or toRealPath and isSameFile (JetBrains). A PATH entry that does not exist when the daemon spawns falls back to a lexical comparison. If that entry's existing ancestor is a junction, symlink, 8.3 short name, subst drive or mapped drive that leads into the project, the entry reads as outside and is kept. A directory created there later, inside the project, then becomes searchable for bare-name spawns.

Direction (the planner decides): walk to the nearest existing ancestor and compare it by identity. That means stat(…, {bigint:true}) dev+ino in VS Code and Files.isSameFile or the fileKey in JetBrains, against the project root and its ancestors. Or drop non-existent PATH entries under the protected profile. Probe SMB and mapped-drive identity natively before relying on dev+ino.

Scope: both IDEs, for parity. VS Code's moe-vscode/src/services/MoeDaemonClient.ts PATH filter, and JetBrains' RuntimeSelectionPolicy.isOutsideProject and MoeDaemonSupervisor.protectedPathEntries. It dependsOn RF06b (032c9739) and 52fb6178, the last open rows on those files.
definitionOfDone: On a Windows host under the protected profile, a PATH entry that does not exist, whose nearest existing ancestor is a junction, symlink, 8.3 name, subst drive or mapped drive leading into the project, is dropped from the protected daemon PATH in both IDEs. An entry under a genuinely outside ancestor is kept. Shown by tests in moe-vscode/tests and RuntimeSelectionPolicyTest that need no network.
Legacy profile, POSIX hosts and the existing protected rows behave as before. Their existing tests pass unchanged.
The verification gates exit 0, with their output supplied to complete_task: `cd moe-vscode && npm test && npm run compile`, and the JetBrains gate (cmd.exe gradlew.bat test --rerun from WSL).
